newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR East plans briefings for overseas investors.
newsitem.headline: JR East plans briefings for overseas investors.

text.p: East Japan Railway Co (JR East) said on Wednesday that its president would brief investors in Britain and the United States on the firm's earnings forecast and financial status.
Starting later this month, Masatake Matsuda would visit London, Glasgow, Edinburgh, New York and Boston, to promote purchases of JR East stock, a company spokesman said.
The spokesman said Matsuda's exact schedule had yet to be set.
JR East is one of seven railway units that were split from the former government-owned railway firm, and the first to go public.
It has issued four million shares so far, and plans to sell 1.5 million more in the future.
